title: Annotatio I §.V open: Lutherans exclude only the tropus that exterminates substance — Bucer & Chytraeus
pass_a_gloss: All these things having been weighed more deeply, the Lutherans themselves desire neither a tropus in another mind, nor any other tropus whatsoever, to be excluded from Christ’s proposition, than in that mind alone, and only that tropus which exterminates the true substance of Christ’s body from the Eucharist — Bucer attesting that at length (Opera Anglicana p. 704 no. 26), and likewise in Chytraeus p. 660 in the middle.
pass_b_english: Weighed more deeply: the Lutherans themselves want only one tropus shut out of This is my body — the kind that drives Christ’s true substance out of the Eucharist.
Bucer (Opera Anglicana p. 704 §26) and Chytraeus (p. 660 mid) attest that limit at length.
source_text: His omnibus altius pensitatis, Lutherani ipsimet, nec alia mente tropum, nec alium tropum quemcunque, propositione Christi exclusum, cupiunt, quàm eâ mente sola, solumque illum tropum, qui corporis Christi veram substantiam Eucharistia exterminat, attestante illud prolixius Bucero, Oper. Anglican. pag. 704. num. 26. itemque apud Chytraeum pag. 660. in med.
notes: §.V open; only substance-exterminating tropus barred; Bucer/Chytraeus.
